title: Claim-to-result provenance
scope: Separate source review; original factual provenance metadata only. The acquisition was partial, not a complete artifact audit.
third_party_rights: Original factual metadata does not relicense articles, bibliography, code, model files, benchmark outputs or linked archives.
verdict: Keep seven collections: five new collection/infrastructure families and two existing-family enrichments. Rank ReScience, HF archives, Crossref/RW. Ranking reflects marginal provenance value, not blanket acquisition or redistribution clearance.
interpretation_guards: Verification states describe specific edges/artifacts; no blanket verified/reproducible boolean.
Repository commit, SWHID, host DOI and content-byte digest remain distinct; all differ from evidence of actual execution.
Preserve contradictions and original observations; supersession requires an explicit correction relationship.
Group duplicate reporting only with native event/artifact evidence; equal names/scores are insufficient.
Replication author claims remain reported replication findings; this review performed no independent execution.
Retraction is work/claim scoped, never an author-profile accusation.
Keep publication, deposit, modification, retrieval and execution clocks separate.
No metric pooling, confidence-interval conversion, p(doom) conversion or operational collection.

original_work.title: When Does Self-supervision Improve Few-shot Learning?

Recorded SWHID is directly visible in the PDF. Tag→commit→tree equality remains unverified; SWH retrieval and execution provenance are not established.

collections.name: Zenodo deposits with DataCite relationships
collections.decision: Use metadata relation/version backbone; deposited file completeness, execution and redistribution remain separately assessed.

rights.zenodo_metadata: CC0 except email addresses, official policy verified

collections.duplicate_evidence: CRP001 article/code records are the same artifacts reviewed here, not another replication. Prior OM002 and PI005 already use Zenodo-hosted artifacts; a new infrastructure family does not create new underlying studies.
collections.next_action: Reuse the same artifact identities across ReScience and registry assertions; hold unresolved code redistribution.
collections.access: Selected anonymous Zenodo and DataCite JSON successfully materialized; no code ZIP or weights acquired.
limitations: DOIs identify deposits/version families, not content checksums. Keep concept DOI, version DOI, SWHID, Git object and byte digest in distinct fields.
Zenodo/DataCite represent one deposit’s attributed relationships; differing metadata times must survive.
Provider-reported ZIP checksum is not independently recomputed. Metadata archive access does not prove every needed artifact was archived or executable.

collections.name: Crossref/Crossmark updates with Retraction Watch attribution
collections.decision: Prioritize production metadata correction edges with notice-level scope and source attribution.
collections.historical_coverage: Retrospective notices; earliest complete year not established. Crossref made Retraction Watch public in September 2023.
collections.update_frequency: Publisher redeposits and Retraction Watch every working day; corrections/expressions of concern less comprehensive than retractions.

sample.scope: Theoretical assumption alpha_i=gamma_i=0 becomes beta_i=gamma_i=0; no numerical-result change reported.

collections.duplicate_evidence: One notice with two source assertions, plus reverse relations, remains one update event. SP002 A-Lab and PI005 correction/concern chains are distinct studies that can reuse this relation pattern. TD003 is a distinct synthetic-feedback study, not the Nature study merely because the topic overlaps. IPP002 throughput correction remains the same earlier evidence event.
collections.next_action: Map the two checked notice chains with separate assertions and affected-claim scope; no author profile flags.
collections.access: Selected production REST records and official notices verified; no CSV corpus downloaded.
limitations: 29 May 2026 deprecation stops new Crossmark/Retraction Watch update annotations to Labs; existing annotations remain. Use production REST.
Absence of a relationship means no update observed, not never corrected.
Only the work/claim affected by an official notice is annotated; do not infer author-level misconduct or unrelated result invalidity.
